result.description: Aurivox Nebula Prism 27 is a fictional 27-inch desktop display built for everyday productivity and casual creative work. It features a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 75 Hz refresh rate, and USB-C input with DisplayPort alt mode for single-cable connectivity. The matte black chassis includes tilt and height adjustment, slim bezels, and built-in 2 x 3 W speakers for a compact workspace setup.
